text:
In my dedo the anillo,

the guirnalda nupcial my sien decora;

of sedas and diamantes busco the brillo,

and I am feliz now.


And my señor me brinda love seguro;

but to the decirme ayer cuánto me adora,

tembló my heart, as to the conjuro,

of “quien cayó in the guerra”, to the pie of the muro,

and that is feliz now.


But él tranquilizome, and in my frente

besó the palidez that it enamora.

And he here that in a ensueño, vi presente,

to the dead D’Elormy: -suyo, in my frente,

was the beso; and suspiré (¡cuán dulcemente!):

“-¡Ah, I am feliz now!”


And if pude otorgar word nueva,

así the voto juré, and aunque traidora,

and aunque a luto of love the alma lleva,

vean brillar ese anillo that “me prueba”

that I am feliz now.


¡Ah! ilumíneme God aquel pasado,

pues if sueña or not sueña the alma ignora,

and the heart is oprime, and conturbado

pregúntase, oh Señor, if the “Olvidado”

será feliz now!

translation.title: Balada nupcial
